```js
loadScripts(tabScripts, function() {
  loadTabs(tabs);
  applyAppTitle();   // still after sequential tab-script loading
  checkApMode();
});
```

It is *better* than before — `/api/app` is now fetched in parallel with `/api/tabs` at boot, so there is no extra round-trip once the scripts finish — but the visible flip still happens late.

### Why it was left this way, deliberately

An intermediate commit on #136 did apply the title early. That broke four `backup.spec.ts` tests, because the portal's e2e helper uses "`#portal-title` has changed" as its readiness gate:


3. Update `bootAndNavigateToBackup()` (and any sibling helper using the same gate) to wait on that marker instead of on the title.
